kbmi.loc: PDF p. 75 (printed p. 74), Awards - Bisnis Indonesia (Financial) Award 2025: 'Best Performance Bank KBMI IV', 'Most Efficient Bank KBMI IV'
kbmi.note: KBMI 4 = core capital above Rp70 tn under POJK 12/POJK.03/2021. No explicit regulatory classification sentence was found in the AR/FS/decks; the tier is stated only through award categories that name BCA as a KBMI IV bank (also AR2024 p. 109 'Category: Conventional Bank, KBMI 4'). BCA Tier-1 capital is about Rp275 tn (Sep-2026 risk exposure report), far above the threshold.

research_notes: Source policy: profit, EPS, total assets, equity and shares_out are from each year's own audited consolidated FS (EN edition on bca.co.id). Loans and deposits are from the AR 'Key Financial Highlights' tables because the FS face shows net loans only. Ratios are from the AR 'Financial Ratios' tables: AR2025 for 2021-2025 and AR2024 for 2020. CoC and NPL coverage come from the bank-only 'Key Ratios' slides of the FY22 deck (2020-2022) and the FY25 deck (2023-2025). Payout ratios and year-end prices are from the AR share and dividend tables.

Ratio basis: the AR footnote 5 says the financial ratios are 'parent company only' (SEOJK 9/2020). The exception is CASA, which is labelled '(consolidated)'. All CoC and NPL coverage values come from slides headed 'Bank Only'. ROE follows the OJK definition: profit after tax divided by average Tier-1 capital.

2021 stock split 1:5. The regular-market ex-date is 2021-10-13, the first regular-market trading day at the new Rp12.50 nominal per the company's 2021-10-07 schedule notice. The ARs say 'October 15, 2021', which is the KSEI distribution and cash-market date. share_basis rules: FY2020 EPS (Rp1,100) and FY2020 shares_out (24,655,010,000) come from FS2020, authorised 2021-01-29, so they are pre-split and the adjuster divides or multiplies by 5. Both FY2020 dividends (98 announced 2020-12-01; 432 announced 2021-03-31) are stored as originally paid with their announcement dates. All AR price and EPS tables published after Oct-2021 are already split-adjusted, so their share_basis is the publication date.

FY2020 DPS check confirmed: AGM 2021-03-29 set Rp530/share (98 interim + 432 final; totals Rp2,416,190,980,000 + Rp10,650,964,320,000 = Rp13,067,155,300,000). AR2024 p. 21 prints the split-adjusted 19.6 + 86.4 = 106.0 and a payout of 48.2%.

The SCHEMA.md example dates for the FY2020 final (cum 04-01, ex 04-05, record 04-06, pay 04-29) do not match the company notice of 2021-03-31: cum 2021-04-07, ex 2021-04-08, record 2021-04-09, pay 2021-04-28. The notice dates are stored.

CIR restatement: AR2025 restated 2021-2024 CIR after the PSAK 117 (IFRS 17) presentation change (net insurance income line; operating income incl. trading/FX). AR2025 prints 2024 31.3, 2023 33.9, 2022 34.9, 2021 34.8. AR2024 printed 31.5, 34.1, 35.1, 34.9. The FY22 deck printed 33.9 for 2022. The stored series is AR2025 for 2021-2025 plus 37.4 for 2020 from AR2024. 2020 is therefore on the older presentation; treat the 2020-to-2021 CIR change with care.

LAR/NPL definition drift: AR2023, the FY21 deck and the FY22 deck print LAR 2020 18.8 / 2021 14.6 / 2022 10.0 and NPL 2022 1.7%. AR2024 and AR2025 print 19.7 / 15.2 / 10.4 and NPL 2022 1.8% (footnote 8: SML + NPL + restructured-current). The AR2024/AR2025 series is stored because it is internally consistent and matches the FY25 deck for 2023-2025.

ROA definition change: AR2021 and the FY21 deck reported pre-tax ROA (2020 3.3%, 2021 3.4%). The stored values are the after-tax ROA from AR2024/AR2025 (2.7%, 2.8%), and the FY22 deck labels the same series 'ROA (after tax)'.

CoC: the deck 'COC' = gross loan provision / average loans. The 9M26 deck splits it into 'CoC (gross)' and 'CoC (after recovery)'. The 9M25 deck 'COC' for 9M-25 (0.5%) equals the 9M26 deck 'CoC (gross)' for 9M-25, so the FY series and the interim value are both gross. The AR MD&A text gives the same 2020-2023 values (1.7, 1.6, 0.7, 0.3).

Treasury shares: BCA bought back shares in 2025 under OJK 13/2023 market-volatility programmes (disclosed 2025-03-25, ended early 2025-05-15; new programme 2025-10-20). The 2026-03-12 AGM approved a further buyback of up to Rp5 tn (disclosure 2026-01-28). Treasury stock was 262,016,800 shares at 2025-12-31 and 433,298,700 at 2026-09-30. shares_out is net of treasury, and EPS uses weighted-average shares (FY2025 123,244,982,342; 9M26 122,862,306,362). Buybacks are not schema corporate-action types, so none is recorded. There were no rights issues, bonus issues or other splits in 2020-2026; the 2026 AoA amendment keeps 123,275,050,000 issued shares at Rp12.50.

Self-check (split-adjusted, shares_out at FY end): EPS x shares vs profit: 2020 -0.04%, 2021 +0.04%, 2022 -0.13%, 2023 +0.11%, 2024 +0.04%, 2025 -0.16%. Sum DPS x shares vs sum of dividend totals: 2020-2024 within 0.01%; 2025 +0.07%, because the record-date share counts differ from the year-end count as treasury shares changed. Profit x payout vs dividend totals: 2020 +0.08%, 2021 +0.03%, 2022 -0.06%, 2023 -0.05%, 2024 -0.06%. 2025 cannot be checked because payout is null (41,304.508 / 57,537.287 = 71.8%, not stored). No mismatch is above 3%.

Typos found in source documents (not used): AR2025 highlights print 2023 'Net Income' as 48,458 bn, but attributable 48,639 + NCI 19 = 48,658 (AR2024 and FS2023 give 48,658). FS2024 prints the FY2023 final dividend total as Rp28,045,047 juta, while FS2025 prints Rp28,045,074 juta (= 227.5 x 123,275,050,000); the FS2025 figure is stored.
FY2025 payout_ratio is null: AR2025 prints n.a. because it was published before the 2026 AGM, and no later company document states the percentage.

FY2026 dividends: the 2026 AGM authorised up to three quarterly FY2026 interim dividends. Two were paid: Q2 at Rp20 (based on 1Q26) and Q3 at Rp25 (based on 1H26). As of 2026-11-02 no Q4 interim had been announced; the IR dividend-history page has not yet listed the 2026 interims.
Interim (9M2026) loans and deposits are deck figures printed in Rp tn to one decimal (stored x1000), so precision is lower than the FY data. Prior-year comparatives come from the 9M25 deck tables.

year_end_price: the ARs print the Q4 closing price without a date. as_of_date is set to Dec-31 and the true last trading day may be a day or two earlier. Values are split-adjusted: 2020 6,770 (AR2024) equals the original 33,850 / 5.
KBMI 4 is supported only by award categories in AR2025/AR2024 ('Best Performance Bank KBMI IV', 'Conventional Bank, KBMI 4'). No explicit regulatory statement was found in the filings.

IR URL: the schema example path /id/tentang-bca/korporasi/hubungan-investor returned HTTP 404 on 2026-11-02, so the working IR hub /id/tentang-bca/hubungan-investor is used. IDX was not used; every document came from bca.co.id.

The FY21 analyst deck is hosted at a 2023-dated path (Berita-Investor/2023/01/20230124-AM-Deck-FY21.pdf), but its content is FY21 results. It was used only as a cross-check; stored values come from the FY22 deck.
